svg.title: Shared YZ camera: inherited colours above, diagnostic silhouettes below
Radial XYZ source projected along X into YZ; inspection overlay, not physical depth sorting
svg.desc: Body first; contacts and root rings exposed for inspection. Neutral outline, texture and root ink are not inherited pigment. Silhouette mode is a diagnostic pigment override only.
